When a coveted star is at stake, every detail counts, especially the freshness of your ingredients. At Cathay Cargo, our extensive flight network, cold chain assurance, express handling, and IATA CEIV Fresh certification ensure that ingredients sourced from Asia are always delivered fresh. Connect to the freshest gateway in and out of Asia today. Learn more: https://bit.ly/4h33Q5P 一道得獎名菜，每個細節都舉足輕重，新鮮食材尤其關鍵。「國泰—鮮貨運送」憑藉廣泛的航線網絡，嚴格的冷凍鏈管理與IATA鮮活貨物運輸認證，為您提供快捷及專業的運送服務，確保您每一件鮮貨都能時刻保持最佳狀態。新鮮快捷，聯繫亞洲。 了解更多：https://bit.ly/4gR7M9S #cathay #cathaycargo #cathayfresh #TheFreshestGatewayInAndOutOfAsia #aircargo #airfreight #shippingaworldofpossibility #weknowhow
And a whole island's largest export.
Connect to the freshest gateway in and out of Asia.
